summary: Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA VI. Unofficial builds made from a leaked Xbox copy run the opening missions at about 20 fps on high-end graphics cards, short of the 30 fps the consoles hold.

official.note: Rockstar lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. GamesBeat reported in October that a PC version is planned for the first three months of 2027, citing four unnamed sources. Rockstar has not confirmed it.

unofficial.eta: No project gives a date. The leaker predicted more than 30 fps within a week of 19 November, and a tracker account on X guessed 30 fps around the weekend of 28 November. The best measured sessions are still in the low 20s.
unofficial.caveat: Every unofficial build needs the game’s Xbox files, which so far exist outside a console only as the leaked copy. Take-Two treats the projects as copyright infringement and has had the largest one removed.

safety.note: Nothing here is a download, and no installer for a PC version exists. Security researchers have traced more than 355 websites offering fake GTA VI launchers and found a ready-made malware kit sold to scammers. Fake “KytyPS5 GTA 6” installers and cloned repositories with a zip file in place of code use the real projects’ names.
